column1: # The rows scripts/sync.sh reads, tab-separated; comments and blank lines are ignored.
#     follow branch:<name>   fast-forward to the upstream branch head
#     follow release:<tag>   fast-forward to the newest point release <tag>.<n> (or <tag> itself); a new release
#                            line (the next <tag>) is a human decision: a new mirror row
#     mica/<name> carries the board's commits on top of that mirror; general carries none. flatten: the mirror's
#     submodules are vendored into the tree by one commit (trailer Mica-Flatten: <base>) under the board's commits,
#     which change files inside them. stable:<mirror branch>: the line carries a merge of that stable mirror
#     (README.md, "Stable merges"); the run never replays it, it only reports when a vendor or stable merge round is due
